summary: Iteration 12 - Lead Sources (Paramantra-style universal lead API + website/FB/Google/portal sources). Backend: 26/26 pytest pass (admin CRUD + RBAC, ingest via X-API-KEY/Basic/Bearer/?key=/path key, JSON/form/multipart/XML/GET, Paramantra field mapping, 201/200/400/401/403 codes, duplicate merge across phone formats with enquiry_count+repeat_enquiry activity, round-robin alternation + rep_id override, Google Ads payload + google_key mismatch 401, Meta verify challenge/403 + webhook logs 'error' w/o token, rotate-key old key 401, delete, org isolation vs Skyline admin, SSE delivery admin 0.58s, exec only own leads with masked phone). Also ran 5 concurrent same-phone posts -> single lead (no dup this run). Frontend: Lead Sources page, add dialog (7 type cards), card copy rows, guide dialog per type (Google webhook+key, FB callback+verify token, API guide w/ X-API-KEY/phonefax/curl), copy/email/print present, Send test lead -> 'New live lead' toast, live log dialog, active toggle, rotation chips, reset key (confirm), delete (admin only; manager has no delete btn), Meta bad token shows Meta error toast. Live alert on /leads: lead pushed via API -> toast in 0.64s and kanban updated in 0.65s (admin) / 0.45s (executive, masked phone). Settings shows settings-lead-sources-link, old webhook list gone, /api/webhooks/leads/{source} returns 404/405.

minor.issue: RESEND_API_KEY IS set (not mocked) but every lead alert email fails: 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address ... verify a domain at resend.com/domains'. Admin emails are NOT delivered. Needs verified sending domain (e.g. propzel.tech) + SENDER_EMAIL on that domain.

Duplicate detection is find-then-insert with no unique index/lock; concurrent identical submissions could create 2 leads (did not reproduce with 5 parallel requests, but not guaranteed). Consider unique index on (organization_id, phone_last10) or upsert.
$inc enquiry_count on older leads lacking the field yields 1 instead of 2 (should $inc from implicit 1, e.g. set default via $ifNull pipeline).
executive_ids not validated (accepts 'not-a-user' -> 200). Ignored at assign time, but should 400.
If meta_app_secret not set, webhook accepts unsigned POSTs (anyone with URL can trigger Graph fetches). Acceptable but recommend requiring app secret in production.
Test leads (is_test) are real leads that appear in the pipeline/kanban and counts; no cleanup. Consider filtering is_test or auto-delete.

ui_bugs.issue: Executive can open /lead-sources directly (nav hidden but route unguarded); page renders with 'Insufficient permissions' toasts x2 and empty state. Add role guard/redirect.

action_items: Verify a Resend sending domain and set SENDER_EMAIL on it so admin lead alert emails are delivered (currently all fail with 403 testing-mode error)

critical_code_review_comments: SSE polls Mongo every 0.5s per connected client (raw_db.lead_events) - fine for MVP; add index on lead_events(organization_id, created_at) and consider change streams/pubsub at scale
SSE 'since' uses ISO string $gt; events with identical timestamp could be skipped (very unlikely)
_meta_connect calls me.json()/sub.json() without guarding non-JSON responses -> potential 500
_email_admins sends one email with all admins in 'to' (admins see each other's addresses); consider bcc
